name: Adapting to the humans the system works with
vision_statement: The AI system works in alignment with the humans it serves.
opportunities: Learning when to ask, per person, ordering what reaches the person so their scarce attention goes to what unblocks the most work, and translating priorities that are only implied, are opportunities beyond any risk watch: the same step may need a question for one person and none for another. Feedback can then change specs and metrics without a person repeating a correction.
solution_coherence: Consciousness is where the system adapts to the humans and policies it works for. Representatives are the AI personas that act for a person, carrying that person's authority, data scope, preferences and quality profile. Request Intake takes in what people ask through Intake Sources. The interactive entry is AI Session Experience: a person types in a plain terminal and each line goes through the front door, and a person can also work with the AI while it works, whatever harness does the work and whichever surface (a terminal, a chat page, a task modal) draws it, watching each step and helper, stopping and resuming, sending a correction and seeing it taken up, and approving a risky step; the work and any question are drawn so the next line answers an open question. Prioritization is the one place that orders three things for a person: the work the system is about to start unasked, which Intelligence says is due; the asks that arrive from Judgment Calls once it has decided to ask; and the person's own goals, which Intelligence keeps live. It also turns priorities a person states or implies into ESOI. Judgment Calls decides whether to ask, proceed or decline when a step is risky, and how the ask is timed. Feedback Learning proposes edits to specs and metrics, never to prompts. Those edits are applied directly, with no approval step, unless Judgment Calls decides to ask.
